name: Latent Charge
summary: Digs six cards and lets the d20 decide what you take.

face.name: Latent Charge

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and roll a d20: on 1–5 you may reveal a Matter among them; on 6–13 an Object; on 14–20 an Entity. Add the revealed card to your hand; if you do not reveal one, put one of the looked-at cards on top of your deck. Then put one of the others into your Retire Zone and the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

face.flavor: The deck already knows. The die decides when.
